blocks.text: Like millions of people, my wife and I watched in shock and amazement, on live TV, the catastrophe taking place on September 11, 2001. I chose to stay home and wait for our son to return from school, not knowing when that might be. When he returned, we asked him what he knew before turning the TV back on. We then drove up a nearby mountain with a long distance view of Manhattan and joined others who had gathered to see the smoke from the destroyed Twin Towers drift over the city skyline. That’s when I began to photograph, telling my son that he would always have pictures of himself the day the world changed. The pictures in this portfolio are all related to that day as witnessed in memorials and commemorations over the next several years.
